title: How many profiling floats it takes to map subsurface oxygen and nitrate
query: Treat the supplied CMEMS global biogeochemical reanalysis monthly oxygen and nitrate for 1993-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W) as the true ocean. Simulate sampling it with a small number of profiling floats, and determine how accurately the regional mean and the spatial pattern between 100 and 500 m can be reconstructed as the number of floats grows, where an additional float reduces the error most, and how the answer depends on the season and on whether the monthly state or the long-term mean is wanted. State what an experiment based on a reanalysis cannot tell about sampling the real ocean.
